# plthook

This directory vendors the ELF implementation and public header from
[`kubo/plthook`](https://github.com/kubo/plthook) at commit
`24c69df003310fb91f9c2950b5a659ff70e9dfb9`.

The files are unmodified and retain their BSD-2-Clause license notices. They are
built from source as part of the Android bootstrap; no prebuilt plthook archive
is distributed or required.
